# Invoice Focus

> Free online document generator for creating invoices, quotes, estimates, receipts, credit notes, and purchase orders. Built for freelancers, agencies, consultants, and small businesses.

## Product
- [Home](https://invoicefocus.com/): Create invoices, quotes, estimates, receipts, credit notes, and purchase orders as print-ready PDFs.
- [How It Works](https://invoicefocus.com/how-it-works): Step-by-step process from document type to exported PDF.
- [About](https://invoicefocus.com/about): What Invoice Focus is and who it's built for.

## Templates
- [Quote Templates](https://invoicefocus.com/quote-template): Minimal, professional, and enterprise quote template families.

## Resources
- [Blog](https://invoicefocus.com/blog): Practical guides on invoicing, quotes, and billing documents.
